text:
Build a work plan covering all 24 modules (every module is named below). "→" means depends on. Everything not listed is your call.

Fixed: upload.batch_size=200 billing.batch_size=750 quota.batch_size=900 ledger.batch_size=450 export.batch_size=350 session.batch_size=250 search.batch_size=200 gateway.batch_size=450 metrics.queue_depth=270 media.queue_depth=490 alerts.timeout_s=20 export.timeout_s=90 checkout.ttl_s=360 feed.retry_limit=9 sync.retry_limit=8 pricing.retry_limit=6

Conditionals (if left, then right): feed.retry_limit>6→shipping.retry_limit≤1 search.batch_size>100→reports.retry_limit≤2 quota.batch_size>800→archive.batch_size≤200 upload.batch_size>150→ingest.queue_depth≤20 export.batch_size>250→inventory.timeout_s≥120 ledger.batch_size>400→quota.queue_depth≥500 media.queue_depth>480→ingest.batch_size≥900 checkout.ttl_s>270→catalog.max_workers≤4

Workers: media=alpha; catalog,inventory,alerts=beta; reports,profile=gamma; metrics,ledger=delta.

Same worker: ingest+checkout, archive+scheduler, returns+billing, shipping+upload. Separate workers: checkout/sync, export/feed, catalog/shipping, billing/checkout.

Dependencies: inventory→export, returns→pricing, gateway→feed, gateway→metrics, checkout→export, archive→export, shipping→search, pricing→reports.

Forbidden (direct or transitive): search→feed, sync→media, session→ledger, archive→ingest.

Order: metrics before reports; feed before scheduler; quota before session; checkout before shipping.

Files: core.py→metrics, hooks.py→shipping, fixtures.py→scheduler, limits.py→inventory, adapters.py→returns, specs.py→checkout, worker.py→billing, routes.py→media.
